framework.name: Pillar 1: Life-Saving and sustaining Basic Services, Community Stabilization & Resilience.

children.name: Outcome 1- By 2023, the populations in vulnerable situations have improved health, nutrition, education, water and sanitation, and social protection outcomes
Output 1.1.1:  Targeted population have improved access to and use of quality preventive and curative health and nutrition services.
Output 1.1.2 : Targeted population have improved access to/and use of safe and adequate WASH services
Output 1.1.3: Equitable access to quality education is improved for school-aged children and youths

Output 1.1.4: National and sub-national government partners have strengthened institutional capacities to develop and deliver child and women-sensitive social protection, particularly to children and families in the most-vulnerable situations

Outcome 3 - By 2023, people in Sudan, with growth in entrepreneurship, technology development for research and innovation, and access to small-scale industrial enterprises through financial services and integration into value chains, will enhance their infrastructure through strengthened governance, guidance, tools, and knowledge.
Output 1.3.1: increased access of target populations to improved manugaturing productive capacity
Output 1.3.2:  Target populations benefited from vocational training  environmental technologies and innovations by local private microfinance.
Output 1.3.3: Target populations have increase access to infrastucture assets, soalr energy and manage solid waste.

Outcome 2 - By 2023, people in Sudan, with emphasis on small producers and micro-entrepreneurs, have access to improved productive capacities  that contribute to inclusive and sustainable livelihoods, job creation and ending extreme poverty Reduction and Economic Development
Output 1.2.1 Government institutions have strengthened capacities for evidence-informed policy formulation to promote priority setting and appropriate practices for sustainable economic development
Output 1.2.2: Targeted populations increasded  productived capacities
Output 1.2.3: Rural institutions and businesses are strengthened to promote socio-economic development

framework.name: Pillar 2: Protection of Civilians, Human Rights, and Rule of Law.

children.code: Pillar 2:  Support prevention and physical protection of civilians
children.name: Outcome 2.1: By 2023, people of Sudan including migrants and vulnerable populations have enhanced prevention and protection against all forms of human rights violations and conflict-related risks

children.code: 01 Pillar 2.1:Support prevention and physical protection of civilians:
children.name: Output 2.1.1: Increased access of migrants and vulnerable populations to facilities providing humane and safe reception, protection and response services;

children.code: 02 Pillar 2.1:Support prevention and physical protection of civilians
children.name: Output 2.1.2: Increased access of target population to public justice and rule of law;

children.code: 03 Pillar 2.1:Support prevention and physical protection of civilians
children.name: Output 2.1.3: Improved knowledge of the targeted population on human rights and humanitarian law including the protection of civilian principles and norms.

children.code: Pillar 2: Enabling environment for respect of human rights and justice
children.name: Outcome 2.2: By 2023, national, state, and local institutions’ systems and capacities improved to respect human rights, freedoms, and justice for service delivery and rule of law including to migrants and vulnerable populations.

children.code: 01 Pillar 2.2: Enabling environment for respect of human rights and justice
children.name: Output 2.2.1: targeted government legislative framework aligned with peace agreements and international standards and norms on human rights, non-discrimination, gender equality, and the rule of law

children.code: 02 Pillar 2.2: Enabling environment for respect of human rights and justice
children.name: Output 2.2.2:  Strengthened capacities of the community protection networks for identification and confirmation of nationality based on national laws and policies.

children.code: 03 Pillar 2.2: Enabling environment for respect of human rights and justice
children.name: Output 2.2.3 Strengthened capacities of national, state and community-based institutions for SGBV and CVR prevention and response;

framework.name: Pillar 3: Peace, Conflict Prevention, and democratic transition.

children.name: Outcome:  By 2023, political transition progresses toward democratic governance where national, state and local institutions are more effective to carry out their mandates efficiently
Output 3.1.1:  Consultations and political negotiations among Sudanese stakeholders find a path out of the current political crisis and towards democratic transition are supported
Output 3.1.2:  A constitution-making commission established and capacitated to ensure the beginning of a participatory constitution making process
Output 3.1.3:  Enhanced public awareness of the consultations and talks at national, state and local levels to counter hate speech, misinformation and disinformation campaigns

Outcome: By 2023, effective conflict management mechanisms, peace dividends and durable solutions that augment peaceful coexistence and social cohesion for community security and stabilization of people improved
Output 3.2.1:  Implementation of the Juba Peace Agreement (JPA) progress steadily and ceasefire among the armed forces maintained
Output 3.2.2: Government partners have increased capacities to develop and implement frameworks, policies, strategies and action plans on issues supporting peace building and durable solutions.
Output 3.2.3: Conflict resolution mechanisms, initiatives and networks for peace dialogue are strengthened at community and state level including the participation of youth and women
Output 3.2.4: Women and youth peacebuilder organizations and networks have improved capacity to prevent violence and promote social peace and co-existence
